title: A Cancelled column for cards that will not be done
notes:
The user does not like deleting cards; a card that will not be done should be kept, in a Cancelled column.

- Every board gets a Cancelled column after Done: a CANCELLED_COLUMN constant beside DONE_COLUMN in src/shared/board/board.ts, added to a board's columns.json on read when missing (no hand edits; an old board.json board too), with its own glyph in icons.ts COLUMN_GLYPHS.
- A move into Cancelled goes through card.move (actions-rule-1) and starts nothing: add its row to column-entry.ts's transition table. Moving out of Cancelled is allowed like any column (unlike Done's lock, board-decision-3); say why in a decision.
- The delete key on a card moves it to Cancelled instead of deleting it. Only a card already in Cancelled is deleted for good, after the existing confirm. The help row and blurb say so (keys-rule-2).
- The board command: board move <id> Cancelled works and is listed in the usage; board list shows Cancelled cards like Done ones.
- Filters or counts that treat Done as finished treat Cancelled the same way (e.g. the release notes' What's new must not list Cancelled cards: check scripts/release-notes.mjs, which reads Done).
- A cancelled card with a worktree keeps it; the worktree dialog can remove it as now.

Tests: the column added on read, the transition row, the delete-moves-to-Cancelled decision, release notes ignoring Cancelled. Docs: board README, decisions, history.
